title: One cd-following helper for the three Bash guards, ending a cd at a subshell's close
notes: Follow-up from #349. package-manager-guard.ts, test-run-guard.ts and the worktree guard each walk a command's cd; only the worktree guard ends a cd when a ( … ) subshell closes. So '(cd storefront && pnpm i) && npm install' in new-crm is judged in storefront and the root npm install is refused. Move the walk to one helper in hook-answer.ts that all three call, with that case as its test.

comments.body: Also from #349's loop: worktree-guard reads 'cd -P <dir>' as cd into '-P'; the shared walk should skip cd's flags. 5ed72c31 on #349's branch (reverted only for a 152-wide comment) already had a correct shared walk to start from.
Also: an msys-style 'cd /c/work' resolves to C:\c\work on Windows, so the guard finds no lockfile and fails open.
